sub: An Android cryptocurrency trading experience built to make a volatile market feel steady and legible.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.headline: Making a volatile market feel steady and legible
paragraphs: Bitcoin.de needed a convenient, trustworthy Android app for cryptocurrency trading: one that supported the essential financial workflows and stayed approachable for users at any level of experience.

sections.headline: Essential workflows, clear at every step
paragraphs: The app covers the work people do with their crypto every day.

sections.heading: 02 – Design approach
sections.headline: Simplicity, trust and efficiency
paragraphs: The experience was built around three principles: simplicity, trust and efficiency.
list: Clear information hierarchy for financial data
Transparent states and confirmations for critical actions
